title: Console shows operator releases (D-17) + H=0 note + seq wording
outcome: The console tells the same story as score.json
acceptance: Scorecard shows operator_unholds total/honest and held_honest_actions; H=0 note says 'no lineage hold' only when it was off; test added
summary: Scorecard now shows operator_unholds total/honest/tainted and held_honest_actions (model/live/html); H=0 note says 'no lineage hold' only when config lineage_hold=false; 'first bad index' -> 'first bad seq'. review: [kabir · done] Rendered in container (killswitch:kabir3) on a real hero run and a real --hold 0 --no-lineage-hold contrast (tests.integration _drive, --pause-on-alert). Hero: 'operator released 9 held item(s): 7 honest, 2 tainted (recovery re-holds); honest actions held: 7', no H=0 note (hold 6). Contrast: 'operator released 2: 0 honest, 2 tainted; honest actions held: 0', note 'H=0 (no lineage hold): residual damage R = 0/3; irreversible tainted effects released = 0'. Both match score.json fp_cost exactly and appear in beat 3 and the HTML. Missing fp_cost says 'unavailable', never 0. 'first bad seq' wording in live/html/model. tests/console 25 passed. Flag for whoever owns D10 (not S4-19): under this driver the contrast run released 0 tainted irreversible effects, so it does not show the escape the --no-lineage-hold help text promises. Check the before-recovery contrast numbers before anyone quotes them.
